# REUI source provenance

Imported from https://github.com/keenthemes/reui/tree/3b67464bcad3c29fbdb12437afb70153384eee19.

The manifest records 1241 distinct public examples across 86 categories, their source paths and SHA-256 hashes. Only one of the equivalent Base/Radix source sets is imported. Original files in source/ are byte-preserved reference material; the adapted runtime has separate source and modification records. Imported source is covered by the retained MIT license. Counts in this manifest describe source inventory, not completed runtime qualification.

Reproduce intake: `node scripts/reui-intake.mjs /path/to/exact-upstream-checkout`.
